gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Redodo's 12V 120Ah Group 24 trolling-motor Bluetooth battery (120 A continuous BMS, 1,536 Wh) sells for $296.99 on redodopower.com today. That puts 20% more energy than any 100Ah pick in the same Group 24 box, under the $300 cap. The same pass found these maker-store prices on 2026-11-14: WattCycle TM $229.99, Vatrer $259.99, Redodo 100Ah $259.99, and LiTime Bluetooth $311.09, which is over the cap.
standout_why: I compared against these pages. Our own page (dealectric.com, dated 2026-11-03) has no 120Ah row and prices LiTime Bluetooth at $365.99 and Redodo at $289.99, and both are now stale. deal.ai/best (Nov 9) lists LiTime, ECO-WORTHY, Dyness, Redodo 100Ah and others with mostly eBay and Amazon prices. It has no WattCycle, no Vatrer and no 120Ah Group 24. wpa-pool.com (Oct 2026) names SUPER EMPOWER, DC HOUSE, HeyFuture and others with no prices at all. Nautworthy gives LiTime at $311.09 (seen 23 Sep 2026) and nothing else in the category. The cited Vatrer, WattCycle and Redodo 100Ah product pages each state only their own price. I could not open the solargenadvisor pages (TLS error) or Redodo's uncited trolling-motor collection page (result 14), so either of them might list the 120Ah model.
decides: The answer is still Vatrer versus WattCycle for a 100Ah Group 24, but price now favours WattCycle. WattCycle's own store states 'Max. Continuous 120A Current' and IP67 at $229.99. That settles the 100 A versus 120 A conflict ChatGPT flagged from the Walmart listing. Vatrer's 150 A BMS costs $30 more at $259.99 and has IP65. Redodo's 100Ah Group 24 Bluetooth has dropped to $259.99, the same as Vatrer, so it now loses to Vatrer on BMS headroom (100 A vs 150 A). LiTime's new Group 24 Bluetooth ($311.09) is over the cap and drops out. For a shopper who will take more than 100Ah in a Group 24 box, the Redodo 120Ah at $296.99 is the only under-$300 option found with 120 A continuous and 1,536 Wh. Disclosure: both Redodo models and the Vatrer are Dealectric affiliate products (awin).
